title: Practice 19: Time in a complex sentence

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.ru: ___ Леонардо слушал рассказ, из-за дверей приемной послышалась музыка и пение.
exercises.why: «Пока is used as an adverb of time and as a conjunction. Пока не (until) is a conjunction … ПОКА НЕ has no negative meaning and the particle НЕ is not translated.» — DLI, Lesson 105. From Дмитрий Мережковский, «Воскресшие боги».

exercises.q: War is when the young and stupid are tricked by the old and bitter into killing each other.
exercises.ru: Война – это ___ злобные старики науськивают глупых юнцов убивать друг друга.
exercises.why: «Future tense after "когда" and "как только" … » and «the complex conjunctions: до того как, после того как, перед тем как». — DLI, Lessons 37, 92. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.ru: Мужиков — за ___, что они плохие гастрономы.
exercises.why: «When a preposition refers to a whole clause, a complex conjunction is used consisting of: 1) the preposition, 2) the pronoun "то" in the case required by the preposition, 3) a linking word»: до того как, перед тем как, о том что, за то что, вместо того чтобы. — DLI, Lesson 92. From Антон Чехов, «Прощение».
